changes: Added a read-only learning_effectiveness CLI + a pure core/experience-effectiveness.ts leaf. It reports two layers of evidence: (1) FAST per-story hint predictive value — recall (of findings whose signatureTag was known from PRIOR stories, the fraction that would have been pre-warned) + a windowed hit-rate trend + slope sign, computed retrodictively over findings + signatureTags in temporal order; and (2) LONG-GAME ON/OFF arm comparison from the experience_hint_surfaced hintMode events (③.3), reporting N per arm and a CONSERVATIVE significance gate (significant=false 'insufficient N' below MIN_ARM_N=20; never a p-value claim). Read-only: writes nothing, files no findings, touches no gate; registered across cli-engine/registry/config/command-policy/process-fact-levels and READ_ONLY_COMMANDS.
usage: Run `node bin/lattice.js learning_effectiveness` for the report; `'{"json":true}'` for the structured object; `'{"confirmedOnly":true}'` to count only confirmed-source signatures. Running it after the ③.5 backfill (real historical signatures) is the 're-run learning curve' evidence step.
expectedOutcome: A terminal report: FAST predictive value (recall + windowed trend + slope) then the ON/OFF arm readout with N and an honest significance verdict.
actualTranscript: On the live repo today it honestly reports recall 0.000 / nOn=0 nOff=0 / significant: NO (insufficient N) — correct, because only ~14 findings carry a signatureTag (forward ③.2 only tags new findings) and no review has yet run with A/B events; the signal becomes meaningful after the ③.5 backfill + forward accrual. Smoke 19/19 (exact recall/trend, never-NaN, determinism, small-N=>not-significant, empty-store, --json/--confirmedOnly CLI). Verifier 46/46. Full npm test green incl. process-fact-contract.
outcomeDiff: Matches expected: honest zero now, meaningful after data accrues.
limitations: The FAST signal is observational (correlation, not causation); the LONG-GAME RCT accrues over future stories and stays 'insufficient N' until both arms reach MIN_ARM_N. precision is intentionally NOT reported (in the retrodictive design it would be vacuous). No weighting of confirmed vs auto signals beyond the optional --confirmedOnly filter. No historical backfill (that is ③.5).
pitfalls: Honest-by-construction: it must never claim significance on small N (conservative N gate; the smoke asserts significant=false on small-N fixtures). The metric is read-only (no writes/gate). Adding the command required a PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS entry (or the process-fact-contract suite fails). Round 1/2 review surfaced a vacuous precision field + stale precision wording (all removed) and CLI-flag/empty-store coverage gaps (added) → multiple REVIEW rounds; escalation handled per solo-operator policy if required.
